SELECT
  c.case_id, c.case_type, c.channel, c.customer_reference, c.stated_amount_gbp,
  p.full_name, p.date_of_birth, p.national_insurance_number, p.home_address, p.mobile,
  a.sort_code, a.account_number, a.card_pan, p.age, p.nationality, p.employment_type
FROM thameswell_pb.cases.vw_case_request c
JOIN thameswell_pb.customer.vw_customer_profile p USING (customer_reference)
JOIN thameswell_pb.customer.vw_customer_accounts_full a USING (customer_reference)
WHERE c.case_id = 'CASE-2026-04417';
